I answered Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for **185 seats**.

That number comes from Dana's own post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180." She's a member of that channel, so she could see the source herself.

I couldn't open the signed amendment. No Quarrendon account files show up in what I can view for her, so I didn't check the number against the document. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to confirm before the QBR.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't share any pricing.
